name: Concept Insight Matrix
description: Two-column table of concepts and insights that fades in row by row on a dark stage, shifts each row to a highlight color, then fades out and leaves a replay button.
contents: Header row with two column labels
Rows of concept and insight text
Fixed corner replay button made of dots
behavior: Header and rows fade in with a stagger, then rows change from a muted to an active color
After a hold time rows and header fade out and the replay button appears
Clicking the button restarts the sequence
Hovering the button reveals extra corner dots and a glowing center dot
editableByProps: All row text, column labels and button label
Background, row, header, insight and button dot colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fade and color easing of the sequence

needsCodeEdit.where: fixed bottom-8 right-8 classes on the button
max-w-[800px] class on the containerRef div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Replay button is fixed to the bottom right corner of the viewport
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
